target: Fractional seconds from snapshot time to verified gate arrival. Select the latest outcome known strictly before the fold validation-label cutoff; require positive remaining time and second or minute precision. Apply the identical unrounded target to all methods.
availability_denominator: All frozen validation opportunities, including unknown outcomes and nonpositive remaining time. Count native, historical-baseline fallback and unavailable separately.

cohorts.native: Eligible opportunities on which this method emitted its own quantiles.
cohorts.common_native: Identical eligible opportunities on which all three methods emitted their own quantiles.
cohorts.delivered: Eligible opportunities on which this method delivered quantiles, including recorded fallback.
cohorts.baseline_anchor: All baseline-supported eligible opportunities. A candidate that loses any baseline-supported opportunity is ineligible for promotion. Score the published forecasts including fallback on this fixed set.

weighting: Within each reported cohort or slice first average snapshots of each tenant/trip, then give each scored trip equal weight. RMSE is the square root of the trip-weighted mean squared error.

bootstrap.method: Percentile interval for candidate minus baseline MAE on the baseline anchor. Resample whole tenant/trip contributions with replacement within each fold; preserve each fold's number of scored trips. Use the same samples for all candidates.

selection.decision: Retain the baseline unless a candidate meets every gate. Of qualifying candidates take the simplest within 1% of the lowest anchor MAE. If a gate has no denominator or paired interval it fails. Advance one method and preserve historical fallback for the next stage.

scope: Synthetic, chronological training-period validation only. No hyperparameter search or refit. July calibration, final held-out scoring, calibrated coverage, operational benefit and production acceptance require separate evidence. Gates are engineering choices for this experiment.
